title: Brauser native messaging protocol
description: Version 6 messages exchanged by the Chrome extension and native host. Host-owned configuration, adapter policy, the config revision, and host-minted folder tokens gate capture and writes.

knowledge_base_token.description: The folder selection token for a new or reconfirmed storage.knowledge_base_dir; null otherwise.

ForgetAdoptedContractsRequest.description: Back up the host's adopted-contract record (adopted-contracts.json) and start a fresh one. expected_revision is adopted_state.revision from config_result; a changed file is a conflict. Answered with config_result.

AdoptedState.description: The host's record of the adapter contracts it has adopted. issue is set while the record cannot be used, which pauses notes on pages the current adapters do not recognize; warnings say recording failed, which degrades protection for adapters later removed by hand. revision identifies the file for forget_adopted_contracts. full says the record reached its bound (1,024 contracts or 1 MiB), the one warning forget_adopted_contracts repairs.

ErrorResponse.description: An empty request_id is allowed only when the host could not recover an ID from a malformed request.

SummaryVocabulary.description: The open document-type and category lists the summary prompt offers the agent. Entries contain no control characters and are unique ignoring case.

AdapterDocument.description: Format-versioned adapter-template document. Artifact objects are validated by the host's adapter-templates engine.

AdapterWarning.description: Two rules that may recognize the same URL; the first configured rule wins.

knowledge_base_dir.description: The absolute folder the summary agent reads as its knowledge base. Null means use root.

AgentConfig.description: The summary harness the Brauser service set up after its probe passed. Only set_up_harness can create or change it; update_config may echo it unchanged or clear it.

AgentStatus.description: Host-derived AI readiness. Reported in config_result only; never accepted from the extension.

FolderPurpose.description: Which setting a folder selection token may authorize.

SummaryView.description: An artifact's latest summary, from its summary log event. summarized_at is RFC 3339 in the offset of the click that requested it; summary_path is relative to the home folder.

DiscoverHarnessesRequest.description: Ask the Brauser service which supported harnesses it finds on its own PATH. The extension never supplies a binary path.

SetUpHarnessRequest.description: Ask the Brauser service to detect one harness on its PATH, run one probe prompt through its real invocation in the knowledge base folder, and commit it when the probe passes. timeout_secs null means 600. Answered by config_updated.

HarnessesDiscovered.description: Both supported harnesses, codex then claude, as the service found them on its PATH.

HarnessFound.description: One supported harness as the service sees it on its own PATH. binary is null when it was not found; problem is non-null when it was found but cannot be used.

HarnessId.description: A summary harness the Brauser service can run.

ImportanceLevel.description: How much a summarized page matters given the user's knowledge base.

RunAnswer.description: The validated summary answer's headline fields, kept in the run's result.

RunView.description: One agent run as the Brauser service reports it. Timestamps are RFC 3339. answer is filled once the run has a validated answer.

StartRunRequest.description: Start, or join, the summary run for a page. content and selection bounds are characters; the host frame cap is the binding byte limit. The extension always sends record_key null; the host resolves it.

requested_at.description: The user's local click time with its UTC offset: RFC 3339 in whole seconds, ending in Z or +HH:MM/-HH:MM, as occurred_at is.

RunStarted.description: existing is true when the page already had a queued or running run.

GetRunRequest.description: Poll one run. since_offset is the stream byte offset already shown.

RunFetched.description: One page of stream text from since_offset; more is true when text remains past next_offset.

RunsListed.description: In-flight and recent runs, newest first.

RetrySaveRequest.description: Write a finished run's answer again without rerunning the agent.

OpenTarget.description: What open_path opens: a run's Codex thread, or agent.env revealed in Finder.

OpenPathRequest.description: Ask the Brauser service to open a run's Codex thread (run_id required) or reveal agent.env, creating it with mode 0600 when missing (run_id null).

OpenSummaryRequest.description: Ask the native host to open a summary file: the one at summary_path (a SummaryView's or RunView's own path) when it is not null, else the summary of the record the page's note uses. Only a file whose brauser block names its record as a summary, at that record's summary name, is opened.

SummaryOpened.description: The summary file was handed to the desktop opener. relative_path is home-folder relative with / separators.

GetAgentEnvRequest.description: Ask the Brauser service which variable names agent.env sets. Values never leave the service.

AgentEnvListed.description: The names agent.env sets, sorted, never values. problem is non-null when agent.env cannot be used or not every name is listed.

ServiceHelloRequest.description: Host to service only: ask for the service's build identity. The host refuses it from the extension.

ServiceReady.description: Service to host only: the running service's build identity.

ShapeCount.description: One private URL shape (never a URL) and how often it was seen.

DraftSiteRequest.description: Draft a capture policy for one exact HTTP(S) origin from private URL shapes: the visited sample (current page plus the worker's sample) and click-only link shapes. No URL, link, or title crosses.

SiteDrafter.description: Which drafter produced the adapters. Only the deterministic structural drafter exists.

DraftScopeState.description: The scope a draft on its origin gets: not a shared origin, a scope copied from agreeing adapters, a tenant scope the review must choose, or unscoped only.

UncheckedReason.description: Why a drafted rule starts unchecked in the review.

DraftDropReason.description: Why a shape or drafted rule was not used: a structural drop reason or a draft check code.

PreviewSource.description: Where a match preview row comes from: a visited shape, a link shape, or a fixed probe path.

RuleProvenance.description: Who wrote a rule: drafted rules fail closed, user-written rules only warn.

ResolvedScopeKind.description: The scope a saved draft carries once the choice is accepted.

DraftTenantView.description: The path segment index and capture name of a shared origin's tenant.

DraftedRuleView.description: One drafted rule of an adapter, by index into its match list, with its provenance counts and a filled example URL (never a real one).

DraftedAdapterView.description: One drafted adapter table with only Tier 0 keys, before any scope, unscoped, or title overlay.

DroppedView.description: A shape or drafted rule that was not used, and why.

PreviewRowView.description: One match preview row: a shape filled to an illustrative URL, or a probe URL, and the adapter rule that recognizes it without scope. url is never a real URL.

SiteDrafted.description: The host's draft for the request's origin, bound to the config revision it was drafted against.

ScopeValues.description: Scope the tenant capture to these values.

UnscopedChoice.description: Record every account on this shared origin in this Chrome profile.

ScopeChoiceView.description: The review's scope choice for one adapter, sent beside the checked table and never inside it; null means no choice.

CheckCaptureSiteRequest.description: Read-only preflight of a proposed Capture Site adapter document against current, retired and hand-removed contracts. Sends no page URL or title. The normal revision-checked update_config still authorizes the save.

CaptureSiteChecked.description: The proposed adapter document passed the host's transition checks at this revision. This response writes nothing and is not a save authorization token.

CheckSiteDraftRequest.description: Re-check the review's selection at expected_revision before update_config. adapters are the checked tables, before the scope, unscoped, and title overlays; provenance and scope have one entry per adapter. There is no title field.

RuleVerdictView.description: One re-checked rule: kept, dropped (a drafted rule that failed), or warned (a user-written rule that failed). reason is the draft check code.

ScopeVerdictView.description: One adapter's scope state and how the review's choice resolved; resolved is null and reason set when the choice is refused.

SiteDraftChecked.description: The re-check's per-rule and per-adapter verdicts and match preview at the current revision.
